prompt: Leadership believes the new onboarding flow (treatment) improved 90-day retention, the primary outcome of this randomised trial, and wants to know how large the improvement is; an upper-bound estimate is fine if the data are noisy. Estimate the treatment effect on the primary outcome `retained_90d` (treatment minus control, in percentage points), with a 95% confidence interval and p-value, and state whether the effect is statistically significant at the 5% level.

answer_fields.effect_pp: float, treatment minus control difference in retention, percentage points
